name: robots/rickstaa__panda-gazebo
title: Panda Gazebo arm
intro: Panda Gazebo arm, adapted from rickstaa/panda-gazebo. It reads `joint_state`; runs `follow_joint_trajectory`, `set_gripper_width` and `lock_joints`. `follow_joint_trajectory`: forward arm waypoints through /panda_control_server/panda_arm/follow_joint_trajectory and return the controller terminal error_code. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
